policy_en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). 14–16 Sep snapshots are public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. Sep NFP public pre-print freeze is ship 2026-10-01-1051 (commit c416920); its print result is appended as 2026-10-05-nfp-print without rewriting freeze rows. Results are append-only.
policy_zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。9/14–16 快照是 9/15–16 FOMC 的事前公开冻结。9 月非农公开事前冻盘是船 2026-10-01-1051（commit c416920）；其公布结果以 2026-10-05-nfp-print 追加，冻盘行不改写。结果只追加。
